conventions.clamping: NOT applied - intervals are transcript geometry only. S2 must clamp to the COVAREP span (S0 measured the corpus-wide cost at 0.020s).
conventions.coverage_denominator: max(stop_time) over ALL speakers; COVAREP is indexed from t=0
conventions.interval_units: seconds on the transcript clock, [start, stop)
conventions.merge_rule: merge when next.start <= current.end (overlap OR touch)
conventions.source: RAW tab-delimited transcripts under data/ (data_norm/ drops timestamps)

findings.message: S2 clamping to the audio stream will discard 0.020s of participant speech
